async def act(page):
    # Navigate to Personal projects page to view all projects
    try:
        personal_projects_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Personal projects")
        await personal_projects_link.click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
        print("Navigated to Personal projects page.")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Failed to navigate to Personal projects: {e}")
        return "Cannot access Personal projects page."
    
    # On the Personal projects page, search for 'gimmiethat.space'
    try:
        # Look for a searchbox to filter projects
        searchbox = page.get_by_role("searchbox", name="Filter by name", exact=False)
        await searchbox.fill("gimmiethat.space")
        await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)  # Wait for search results
        # Check if the project appears
        project_heading = page.get_by_role("heading", name="gimmiethat.space", exact=False)
        await project_heading.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=5000)
        project_link = project_heading.get_by_role("link")
        await project_link.click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
        print("Navigated to 'gimmiethat.space' project page.")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Project 'gimmiethat.space' not found via search: {e}")
        # If search fails, try to browse the list directly
        try:
            # Clear search to see all projects
            searchbox = page.get_by_role("searchbox", name="Filter by name", exact=False)
            await searchbox.fill("")
            await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
            # Look for 'gimmiethat.space' in headings
            project_heading = page.get_by_role("heading", name="gimmiethat.space", exact=False)
            await project_heading.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=5000)
            project_link = project_heading.get_by_role("link")
            await project_link.click()
            await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
            print("Navigated to 'gimmiethat.space' project page via browsing.")
        except Exception as e2:
            print(f"Project 'gimmiethat.space' not found in list: {e2}")
            return "Cannot locate 'gimmiethat.space' project."
